## Introduction

This report shows the chemical composition of pottery from different sites. The dataset consists of measurements of various elements, such as Al, Fe, Mg, Ca and Na.

First, we load in the required libraries and the dataset. Then we melt the data into a long format.

```{r loading-data, message=FALSE}
library(car)
library(reshape2)

data(Pottery)
MeltedPottery <- melt(Pottery)
```

## Visualization

In this figure, we see the distribution of the different elements per location.

```{r visualization}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data=MeltedPottery, aes(x=variable, y=value, col=variable)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  facet_grid(. ~ Site) +
  labs(x="Element", y="Concentration", col="Element")
```
